Geemu Chuuban De Shinu Akuyaku Kizoku Ni Tensei Shita Node, Hazure Skill "tame" Wo Kushi Shite Saikyou Wo Mezashite Mita

Ongoing Japanese Action Comedy

The protagonist was reincarnated as a villainous aristocrat from the popular romance action RPG "Symphonia of Swords and Magic"! Although he is destined to be defeated midway through the game, he develops the hidden power of the skill "Tame" and grows at an astonishing speed. Eventually, he gains powers that surpass even the final boss, and as he rewrites his fate, the main heroines start to gather around him for some reason.
